description: This file defines the DocumentOptionsSetup class, which configures DocumentOptions instances using configuration data from the OrchardCore shell configuration system. It sets various properties related to caching, serialization, locking, and expiration policies for document storage.

classes.name: DocumentOptionsSetup
classes.description: A class that configures DocumentOptions objects based on shell configuration and default settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Overloaded method to configure DocumentOptions with default or specified name.

methods.name: Configure(string, DocumentOptions)
methods.description: Configures DocumentOptions based on shared and named configuration sections, setting cache keys, retry latency, concurrency, consistency, serialization, compression, and lock options.
